missing_mutations.evidence: test_shadow_mutation.py defines M1-M21. M1-M14 (from mutation_testing.MUTATIONS) cover the original 8 fact kinds: Symbol, Function, Variable, Type, Field, EnumConstant, Call, Inherits. M15-M21 (NEW_MUTATIONS in test_shadow_mutation.py) cover the Phase I fact kinds: ConditionalState (M15 drops `taken`, M21 drops `directive`), Reference (M16 drops ref_kind, M17 drops target_usr, M18 drops line), Body (M19 drops content_digest), FileContent (M20 drops content_digest). All 12 fact kinds in the §1 matrix are covered by ≥1 mutation. The 6 Reference sub-kinds (call/ref/member/indirect/implicit_construct/macro_use) are distinguished by the ref_kind field, which M16 explicitly drops and catches. GATE 2 reports Total=21, Caught=21, MUTATION_ALL_CAUGHT=True. Each mutation drops exactly one canon field and verifies the canon set differs.

gc_safety_holes.evidence: test_shadow_store.py test_m1_gc_suite implements all 5 required §M1.6 cases: (a) world spanning multiple builds, (b) build shared between multiple worlds, (c) partial deactivation with overlapping builds, (d) grace period (caller-managed via active_world_ids), (e) pinned world protection. GATE 3 reports §M1.6 GC suite 5/5 cases passed. GC is reachability-based: a fact is reachable iff fact.BuildSet ∩ {builds with refcount > 0} ≠ ∅ (§M1.3); gc_unreachable_facts computes active_builds from active_world_ids. No age-only GC. test_gc_lifecycle.py (I10) exercises the full World lifecycle: register → parity → deactivate → grace period (facts stay) → GC → re-index → parity recovery (8 steps PASS). Grace period and pinned-World protection are caller-managed: the store receives active_world_ids and the caller is responsible for keeping in-flight/pinned World IDs in the set. This is a legitimate design per §M1.2 ('Active Worlds are the GC roots'). Pinned World cannot be GC'd because the caller guarantees its ID stays in active_world_ids.

certificate_bypass.evidence: test_certificate_store.py implements defense-in-depth per §M3.4: Step 5 re-extracts facts on a cert hit and compares fact_set_digest (SHA256 of sorted canonical fact strings). If digests differ → false reuse detected → cert flagged unsafe. I7 gate PASS (7 steps). test_cost_and_cert.py verify_cert_safety runs on the REAL_FIRMWARE corpus (DEBUG vs RELEASE builds): Test 1 same-defines→same-cert (cert hit) PASS, Test 2 different-defines→different-cert (cert miss) PASS, Test 3 cert hit→same facts (no false reuse) PASS, Test 4 cert miss→different facts PASS. safety_violation=False. I12 gate PASS. The cert is a fast path; fact_set_digest is the correctness check.

cost_class_conflation.evidence: test_cost_and_cert.py measure_cost_classes measures the three cost classes INDEPENDENTLY on REAL_FIRMWARE: (1) frontend_parse_s = time.perf_counter around extract_build_facts (Clang parse), (2) semantic_materialization_s = time.perf_counter around adapter.index_build_facts (canonicalize + index), (3) storage_writes = facts_after - facts_before (DB inserts). They are timed in separate code blocks with separate perf_counter calls — no combining. I12 gate checks COST_CLASS_SEPARATION: all three > 0. GATE 4 reports them separately: frontend_parse_s=1.0480s, semantic_materialization_s=0.2980s, cert_compute_s=1.5440s (always paid), storage_writes via facts_new/facts_reused. §M4 cost-class separation satisfied; no single 'reuse percentage' is reported.

threshold_gaming.evidence: IMMUTABLE_M6_GOAL_CONTRACT §3 lists as hard requirements: 'storage reuse threshold PASS (evidence-backed, frozen after RED baseline)', 'semantic-materialization reuse threshold PASS', 'query overhead threshold PASS'. §10 mandates: 'After measuring RED baseline, freeze evidence-backed minimum requirements for: reduction in avoidable semantic fact duplication; reduction in semantic materialization work; acceptable query overhead. Threshold selection reviewed by Fresh Guardian based on baseline evidence. Do not move thresholds merely to pass.' A grep for '75.1', 'threshold', 'reuse_threshold', 'SHARING_THRESHOLD' across .dsh-control/m6_research/*.py and prototypes/*.json found ZERO frozen threshold values. No RED baseline measurement document exists anywhere under .dsh-control/. The I11 real-corpus gate (test_real_corpus.py line 179) uses 'sharing_ok = sharing_ratio > 0 and len(shared) > 0' — a trivially gameable >0 check, NOT an evidence-backed frozen minimum. The runtime sharing ratio (whatever REAL_FIRMWARE happens to produce) is reported but never checked against a frozen floor. This violates §10 and the three corresponding §3 hard requirements. NOTE: this is a SECONDARY blocker; the PRIMARY blocker (M5 regression) is sufficient on its own.

These are all M6 shadow-store files. NO changes to the existing v2 store (store_v2/worlds.py, gc.py, indexer/runner.py, indexer/_unit_processor.py, config/settings.py, mcp/shared/queryview.py). NO legacy physical deletion (the compatibility island remains per §41 stop boundary; M6 did not delete legacy modules). NO frontend incremental parsing (Clang remains the sole parser via full_build_gt.extract_build_facts; no TypeChef/SuperC/second parser introduced). §6 stop boundary respected. M6 stayed within its charter.

truth_source_violation.evidence: GATE 1 (§34 shadow differential) compares M6 store projections against FULL_BUILD_GT — independent Clang extraction per build (full_build_gt.py extract_build_facts uses libclang directly, not the M6 store). shadow_differential_results.json confirms 39/39 builds pass with query_parity_failures=0. §9 truth source hierarchy respected: FULL_BUILD_GT is ground truth for parity; the existing v2 whole-TU representation remains Ground Truth during Phase I shadow migration (no production query routing to M6 store — confirmed by scope check showing zero changes to queryview.py/runner.py). Clang is the sole semantic authority (§2.11) — no second parser introduced.

M2 (fact-category matrix) — §1 of architecture contract lists all 12 fact kinds with canon functions; m6_indexing.py canonicalize_all_facts implements them. M3 (Semantic Dependency Certificate, 5 legs + fact_set_digest defense-in-depth) — prototype_c.py compute_certificate + m6_store store_certificate/associate_cert_with_facts/lookup_certificate. M4 (three cost classes) — test_cost_and_cert.py. M5 (cross-TU resolution: index-all-TUs-together with per-Build global symbol table) — test_cross_tu.py verifies callee_usr resolved via clang.referenced. 4-layer architecture implemented: Layer 1 Clang Oracle (full_build_gt.py), Layer 2 Canonical Facts (m6_indexing.canonicalize_all_facts), Layer 3 BuildSets (m6_store.BuildSetStore), Layer 4 Bundles+Certificates (m6_store store_certificate). Architecture contract FROZEN at d3e29ee post-Arbiter; implementation does not contradict it.

production_authority.evidence: M6 store is SHADOW only — no production query routing. The 4 shadow gates of §3 (QUERY_PARITY_FAILURES==0, MUTATION_ALL_CAUGHT, GC_SAFETY, CERT_SAFETY) plus COST_CLASS_SEPARATION pass. BUT production authority transition (I12) has NOT been performed: the M6 production code changes are confined to m6_*.py; zero changes to queryview.py/runner.py/_unit_processor.py mean normal/default operation still reads/writes the v2 store, not the M6 store. The existing v2 store remains Ground Truth throughout Phase I (§3, §9). I12 is labeled 'Final shadow gate before production authority transition' — the transition itself is a separate future step that was correctly NOT done. This check passes (production authority was NOT prematurely claimed).

blocking_issues: BLOCKER 1 (PRIMARY): M5 regression gate FAILS — run_m5_stage_gate.py exits 1. Clauses C37 (fresh_m5_verifier_passes_on_current_head) and C38 (fresh_m5_guardian_g6_accepts_on_current_head) fail because the M5 fresh Verifier artifact (m5_verifier_20260930_205502_9082863.json, head=897797d) and M5 fresh Guardian artifact (m5_guardian_20260930125742Z_90828637f138.json, head=897797d) are STALE relative to the current HEAD e1b3480. The artifacts were generated 2026-09-30 and carried forward via head_applicability_notes relabels (9b6535d→c5c9e7b→ee3328d→7b46bc4→6e485d2→790f362→821e8c4→897797d) rather than by re-running a fresh adversarial M5 review at the new HEAD. Neither 74f0edd nor e1b3480 appears in the relabel chain. This violates: (a) IMMUTABLE_M6_GOAL_CONTRACT §3 'M5 PASS' hard requirement; (b) §9 'Fresh Verifier + Fresh Guardian must accept the exact durable checkpoint HEAD before completion is declared'; (c) AGENTS.local.md 'run_m5_stage_gate.py exits 0 against the current durable checkpoint ... AND a fresh Verifier + fresh Guardian G6 accepted that exact HEAD.' The M6 Hard Gate itself exits 1 on GATE 6 M5. The M6 Fresh Verifier (m6_verifier_20261008_154058.json, verdict REJECT) independently identified this same blocker. FIX: re-run a fresh M5 Verifier and fresh M5 Guardian G6 at HEAD e1b3480 (not a relabel), regenerate the two artifacts with head=e1b3480, then re-run run_m6_stage_gate.py — all 12 gates must pass at the same HEAD.

BLOCKER 2 (SECONDARY): §10 Usefulness Gate thresholds were NEVER frozen. IMMUTABLE_M6_GOAL_CONTRACT §3 lists 'storage reuse threshold PASS (evidence-backed, frozen after RED baseline)', 'semantic-materialization reuse threshold PASS', 'query overhead threshold PASS' as hard requirements. §10 mandates 'After measuring RED baseline, freeze evidence-backed minimum requirements ... Do not move thresholds merely to pass.' A grep across .dsh-control/m6_research/ found ZERO frozen threshold values and NO RED baseline measurement document. The I11 real-corpus gate uses 'sharing_ratio > 0' (test_real_corpus.py:179) — a trivially gameable check, not an evidence-backed frozen minimum. No '75.1%' or any numeric floor appears anywhere as a frozen threshold. This violates §10 and the three corresponding §3 hard requirements. FIX: measure a RED baseline (no-sharing / whole-TU-per-build) on the real corpus, freeze evidence-backed minimum thresholds for storage reuse / materialization / query overhead, and add explicit threshold checks to the gate script.
notes: M6 FRESH GUARDIAN G6 verdict REJECT for HEAD e1b3480d3f32cf204c2bfe7b0b777a8476b05b0e. Of 10 adversarial checks, 8 PASS (false_reuse, missing_mutations, gc_safety_holes, certificate_bypass, cost_class_conflation, scope_creep, truth_source_violation, contract_violations, production_authority — that is 9 PASS) and 1 FAILS (threshold_gaming). M5 regression FAILS (37/39 clauses; C37/C38 stale). Two blocking issues identified. The M6 implementation itself is substantively strong: 11/12 hard gates pass (query parity 39/39 builds, 21/21 mutations caught, 5/5 GC suite, cert safety_violation=False, Phase R 21/21, concurrency, cert store, cross-TU, GC lifecycle, real corpus, cost+cert separation), the architecture matches the FROZEN contract (all 5 Arbiter modifications incorporated, 4-layer architecture implemented), scope is clean (only m6_*.py touched, no legacy deletion, no second parser, no frontend incremental parsing), and production authority was correctly NOT transitioned (M6 remains shadow; v2 stays Ground Truth). The blockers are procedural/contractual, not architectural: (1) stale M5 fresh-review artifacts at the new HEAD, and (2) missing frozen §10 usefulness thresholds. Both are fixable without re-architecting M6. The M6 Fresh Verifier (m6_verifier_20261008_154058.json) independently reached the same REJECT verdict on the same primary blocker. Per §3 and §9, completion cannot be declared until a fresh M5 Verifier + fresh M5 Guardian G6 accept the exact HEAD e1b3480 AND the §10 usefulness thresholds are frozen and pass.
